demo.title: check-token.sh
demo.code:
# Pre-trade safety check on a Base token ($0.02 via x402)
EVM_PRIVATE_KEY=0x... node scripts/check-token.mjs 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

# Free dry-run — prints the 402 price challenge, pays nothing
node scripts/check-token.mjs 0x<token-address>

setup: Install the client deps: `npm i @x402/fetch @x402/evm viem`
Set `EVM_PRIVATE_KEY` to a wallet holding a small USDC float on Base (each check costs $0.02)
Run `node scripts/check-token.mjs 0x<token-address>` before any trade — clean/caution may proceed, rug_risk/exit_trap must not trade
